## Subagent context-window usage

- **The token counter is now the context window.** Running and finished subagents show `168K / 1M` in the sidebar and the subagent inspector instead of the cumulative token total. That total re-counts every turn that was re-sent, so it grew well past the real window; the new figure is the live `window` (input + cache-read tokens of the latest turn), taking the active step when present and falling back to the run.
- **No more vanishing number.** When a run has no window data (older runs, or limits that were never reported), both views fall back to the cumulative token count again instead of showing nothing.

## Compaction lane keeps its tail

- A long streaming summary inside the compaction lane no longer shoves the lane tail off the bottom of the pane. Each streamed line now renders as its own fixed-height row, so the last few lane rows stay visible.

## Consistent token formatting

- Token counts use one shared formatter now, so a million renders as `1M` instead of `1.0M`, and the compaction and subagent views agree.

Full suite: 391 tests — 391 pass, 1 skip.
